record.question: get the median progression-free survival and its 95% confidence interval. Save the output as `pfs`, `ci_high`, and `ci_low`.
record.answer:
{"reference_answer": "
import pandas as pd
from lifelines import KaplanMeierFitter
from lifelines.utils import median_survival_times
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the data
data_clinical_patient = pd.read_csv("/workdir/data_clinical_patient.csv")

# Filter data for PFS and PFS status
data = data_clinical_patient[["PFS_MONTHS", "PFS_STATUS"]].dropna()

data["PFS_STATUS"] = data["PFS_STATUS"].apply(lambda x: 1 if x == "1:Yes" else 0)

# Initialize KaplanMeierFitter
kmf = KaplanMeierFitter()

# Fit the data
kmf.fit(data["PFS_MONTHS"], event_observed=data["PFS_STATUS"], label="PFS")

# Get the median progression-free survival and its 95% confidence interval
median_pfs = kmf.median_survival_time_
ci = median_survival_times(kmf.confidence_interval_)

# Extract the confidence interval values
ci_low = ci.iloc[0, 0]
ci_high = ci.iloc[0, 1]

# Save the output
pfs = median_pfs

# Print the results
print(f"Median PFS: {pfs} months")
print(f"95% CI: ({ci_low}, {ci_high}) months")

# Plot the survival function
ax = plt.subplot(111)
kmf.plot_survival_function(ax=ax)
plt.title("Progression-Free Survival Curve")
plt.xlabel("Time (months)")
plt.ylabel("Survival Probability")
plt.savefig("pfs_curve.png")
plt.show()
